facets.description: GetWebAssets doesn't check the cache again after entryPointAssetsCacheMu.Lock() (line 48), so every waiting caller repeats the load and overwrites the cache
A transient read error from a losing waiter writes nil over a valid cached entry, so callers get an error even though the cache was populated
The exclusive lock stays held during readWebAssetsFromFile/CDN I/O, so all cache misses run one after another
